title: 语言模型中的领域适应与推理框架：以历史宇宙学为受控实验
summary: 通过历史宇宙学受控实验，研究领域适应如何重塑语言模型的解释行为。阶段一从头训练小模型，阶段二用QLoRA微调大模型。结果显示领域适应主要重塑解释框架，立场变化是次要结果。
summary_en: Investigates how domain adaptation reshapes explanatory behavior in language models using historical cosmology as a controlled setting. Results show adaptation primarily reshapes linguistic frameworks, with stance changes emerging secondarily.
